translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: Markus
book.title: Lele Pore Men Ia Tadulkon I MARKUS

content: Yohanes Pansarani nongolukoni i Yesus
Koi kani'imari a tumbena Lele Pore men ringkat ni Yesus Kristus, men Anakna Alaata'ala.
Lele iya'a nosida koi men ia tulis i Nabii Yesaya na kitapna, taena,

content.text: “ ‘Imamat ini'imari! Yaku' bo momosuu' mian-Ku mongolukoni i Kuu.
Bo isian sa'angu' mian na tano' maleas men mengeleelo'kon ka' mambantilkon, taena,

content: Koi men ia tulis i Yesaya, koiya'a uga' a tatakana i Yohanes Pansarani. Ia dumodongo na tano' maleas, ka' nuntundunkon lelena Tumpu, taena, “Sosoli ka' kadarai a gau'muu men ba'idek ka' i kuu tio saranion kada' Alaata'ala mangampuni dosamuu.”
Mian na longkop libutan Yudea ka' giigii' mian na kota Yerusalem notaka na ko'ona. Raaya'a nonsosoli ka' nangkadarai wawauna men sala', ka' ia sarani i Yohanes na Weerkauna Yordan.
Pakean ni Yohanes wuluna unta a niwawau, ka' boborna lolosna anit a niwawau. Kakaanna katumbang tia gurana wani'.
Koi kani'imari a men ia bantilkon i Yohanes mian, taena, “Moko daa i yaku' bo taka i Ia men dauga' labi i yaku' a kuasa-Na. Dumudungku' mangalakai lui'na sapato-Napo,
yaku' koo'.
Ai yaku' mansarani i kuu tia weer, kasee i Ia bo mansarani i kuu tia Alus Molinas.”
Yesus ia sarani i Yohanes Pansarani
Tempo iya'a, ai Yesus norumingkatmo na Nazaret na lipu' Galilea, notaka ni Yohanes. Yesus ia sarani i Yohanes na Weerkauna Yordan.
Sarataa i Yesus no'umuar na weer, Ia nimiile' langit nokobongkatian, ka' Alus Molinas koi marampatii nalau na waka-Na.
Kasi nokamporongoran a wurungna Alaata'ala nda'amari surugaa, tae-Na, “Koomo a Anak-Ku men kolingu'-Ku ka' i Koo a men daa kokana'-Ku.”
Yesus ia topongi Ibiliis na tano' maleas
Noko daa iya'a, Alus Molinas nangandaarkonmo i Yesus na tano' maleas.
Ia dongo-dongo patompulo' ilio na tano' maleas ka' ia topongi Ibiliis. Ia na tanga-tanga'na ayop malela', kasee malaa'ikatna Alaata'ala nansambai Ia.
Yesus notaka na Galilea ka' nengelele'kon Lele Pore
Noko daa i Yohanes nitarungkumo, taka i Yesus na Galilea mengelelekon Lele Pore men ringkat na Alaata'ala,
tae-Na, “Temponamo. Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala karani'mo. Sosoli ka' kadarai a gau'muu men ba'idek ka' parasayamo a Lele Pore men ringkat na Alaata'ala!”
Tempona i Yesus nomae' noso'ole na Danau Galilea, Ia nimiile' i Simon tii Andreas moto'utus. Raaya'a pintanga' muntuong puka' na danau, gause palimangonna i raaya'a pupuka' susum.
Taeni Yesus na ko'ona i raaya'a, “Mai i kuu, lolo' i Yaku', kada' poposidaon-Ku pumuka' mian.”
Raaya'a liuliu namarerei puka'na ka' nongololo' i Yesus.
Ndee-ndee'e Ia nimiile'mo i Yakobus tii Yohanes, anak ni Zebedeus, pintanga' montotobo'i puka'na na lalomna duangan.
Yesus liuliu nengeleelo' i raaya'a ka' raaya'a uga' namarereimo tamana men i Zebedeus tia mian men ia tamboi i raaya'a balimang na duangan, kasi nongololo' i Yesus.
Yesus numbuse'i meena men nangalampingi mian
Noko daa koiya'a, ari Yesus notakamo na kota Kapernaum. Na ilio Sabat, ai Yesus ninsoopmo na laigan bakitumpuan ka' nimisiso' mian.
Raaya'a kodaawan nongorongor pisiso' ni Yesus, gause pimisiso'-Na koi mian men kuasaan ka' poosasala' tia pimisiso'na wawa ukum Torat.
Tempo iya'a, isian sa'angu' mian men ia lampingi meena na lalomna laigan bakitumpuan iya'a. Mian iya'a nangkakaro', taena,
“Oo Yesus samba Nazaret, aupa a urusaan tii kai? Kabai i Koo taka bo pinsilaka'i i kai? Inti'ionku se' i ime i Koo: Koo a men Molinas nda'ara'amari na Alaata'ala.”
Kasee ai Yesus nengerengeaki meena iya'a, taena, “Pimporokot! Uarmo i koo na mian kanono'!”
Meena iya'a ningirimpa-rimpa'konmo mian men ia lampingi, ka' nangkakaro', kasi no'umuar.
Wiwi'na mian men nimiile' nosamba'mo, tamban i raaya'a nopootundunii, taena, “Se', aupa inta ini'i? Sa'angu' pisiso' u'uru men kuasaan. Meenapo posuu'on-Na umuar, ka' raaya'a malolo' na Ko'ona.”
Liuliu notolele a wawau ni Yesus na longkop libutan Galilea.
Yesus nengelesi'i monian ni Simon ka' mian biai'
Tonguar na laigan bakitumpuan iya'a, ari Yesus nomae'mo na laigan ni Simon tii Andreas. Ai Yakobus tii Yohanes uga' nomae'.
Taka inde'e, Ia takai monian ni Simon men sinana boroki'na toko-tokol suminggar. Mian na laigan iya'a liuliu nambantilkon i Yesus.
Ia nomae'mo na tokolanna wiwine iya'a, ningintoni limana ka' nangawangonkon. Wiwine iya'a liuliu nalesi'. Noko daa koiya'a, wiwine iya'a nangkalesangmo i raaya'a.
Guntumalom,
niwawamo ni Yesus a wiwi'na mian men manggeo tia mian men lampingionna meena.
Wiwi'na mian na kota iya'a nobarimpung na soopanna laigan iya'a.
Ia nengelesi'imo mian biai' men biai' kaliangan a nggeona. Ka' Ia uga' numbuse'i meena biai'. Ai Yesus sian namatalai meena iya'a morobu,
gause raaya'a ninginti'imo i Ia.
Yesus nimisiso' mian longkop Galilea
Ma'ulo-ulop tuu', ilio dauga' pintung, Yesus nowangonmo ka' nomae' na liwana kota. Ia nomae' oloa na mian ka' nosambayang.
Kasee i Simon tia mian sambana mae' nansarak i Ia.
Sarataa ia rumpaki i raaya'a, raaya'a nambantilkonmo, taena, “Wiwi'na mian mansarak i Kuu.”
Kasee taeni Yesus, “Mai, kita rae' na dodongoan sambana, na kota men beebeel kaniaale'e, kada' inda'aa uga' ai Yaku' sida mengelelekon Lele Pore, gause i Yaku' notaka bo pengelelekon Lele Pore.”
Kasi i raaya'a nomae' longkop libutan Galilea. Ia nengelelekon Lele Pore na laigan bakitumpuan, ka' numbuse'i meena men nangalampingi mian.
Yesus nengelesi'i sa'angu' mian men kustaon
Tempo iya'a, isian sa'angu' mian kustaon
notaka ni Yesus, ka' nobanintuur na arop-Na. Ia nokitulung ni Yesus, taena, “Kalu i Kuu maloos, Kuu sida mengelesi'i i yaku'.”
Tongkibit a noa ni Yesus nolingu'. Ia doekon a lima-Na nongkoyong mian iya'a, ka' norobu tae-Na, “Daa, Yaku' maloos. Bi poloe'mo i koo!”
Tempo iya'a uga', na'anumo a kustana mian iya'a. Ia liuliu nalesi'.
Liuliu i Yesus nomosuu' mian iya'a mae' na imamna Yahudi, ka' nomotoo, tae-Na,

“Imamatoon pore-pore! Alia i koo mambantilkon ni imepo, kasee rae' na imam ka' pipiile'kon na ko'ona se' kustaam daa na'anumo. Moko daa iya'a kasi rookon a kurbaan koi men ia posuu'kon i Musa na ukum Torat kada' manasa na mian se' kustaam tuutuu' na'anumo.”

Kasee mian iya'a nomae' nuntundunkon ka' nontolele'kon na mian biai' upa men nosida na wakana. Noko daa koiya'a, ai Yesus sianmo ningkakateda minsoop na kota. Ia somo na liwana kota, na tampat men sianta mianna. Mau koiya'a, mian na sanda' lembo' dauga' sataka-taka na Ko'ona.

footnotes.text: sapatonapo: dudusna sapato men olukon koi sandaal kasee isian lui'na.
guntumalom: Aturanna agama Yahudi, tiodaa sopok a ilio na Ilio Sabat, kasi i raaya'a sida balimang soosoodo.
sian namatalai meena iya'a morobu: Panduung ni Yesus nongkokundakon meena iya'a dako' i raaya'a mangaani i Ia ka' noa na mian biai' sida kosinga (piile' uga' 3:12).
mian kustaon: Koi aturanna agama Yahudi, kusta minsidakon mianna sian sida muntunde' Alaata'ala na laigan bakitumpuan.
